description:
Enable and verify proper tree shaking configuration in bundler. Audit imports to use named imports and remove unused module exports from production bundles.

**Rationale:** Eliminates dead code automatically, reducing bundle size by 10-30% without changing functionality. Higher impact with larger dependency trees.
title: Configure Bundle Tree Shaking
